reviews.text: Coco is very happy! It's an ideal place, the girls are very friendly and you can tell they really love dogs! I highly recommend it!
A very good daycare; my dog ​​was nervous the first few days, but now it's like going to school. The staff is very attentive.
I recently had to find a doggy daycare for Wind... and I highly recommend Dogterra. The staff is friendly and attentive. Totally recommend it.
Chicha goes to school happily! She's very happy with her friends and is always happy during activities! She also goes for walks with great joy! I highly recommend it :)

I've taken Aurorita to DogTerra Castillejos three or four times now, and I've taken her to the one in Calabria three or four times before that, and I have to say she's been very happy at both places. She seems content with the activities and walks, which is the most important thing for me. We tried some other sitters in the past, and she didn't seem nearly as happy. The activities are fantastic, and I feel much more at ease leaving her here than alone at home for hours! Well done to the ladies at Castillejos; they're always so nice!
A very good team, thank you!

The best dog daycare in Barcelona! The staff are amazing; they take care of my dog ​​like he's their own, and he's always so happy when he gets home. They send me videos all the time of how much fun they're having.

We came from Seville to visit the city and discovered this place to leave our little dog for a while. We couldn't be happier with the experience. Toby is a small puppy who finds it hard to socialize. We left him there twice, and the second time he was already coming in on his own, wagging his tail. They sent us videos to check on him and were always attentive; his happiness spoke volumes. The women there are lovely and took wonderful care of Toby. You can see the love and dedication they put into their work. Without a doubt, this service saved us in a pinch and far exceeded our expectations.

Very disappointing experience with Dogtera, and unfortunately this is now the second serious issue we have had with them.

About one month ago, we brought one of our dogs for grooming and he came back with one eye in very bad condition, which required us to take care of the problem afterwards. Despite that experience, we decided to give Dogtera another chance.

Today we arrived for an appointment that had been booked around two weeks in advance for our Chow Chow. When we arrived, we were suddenly told that they would not accept him unless we purchased a specific shampoo. This had never been communicated to us as a requirement when making the appointment. Previously, the shampoo had only been recommended to us, not presented as something mandatory for them to groom our dog.

After already bringing the dogs there for the appointment, we were basically told to leave, go and buy the shampoo and then come back. The whole situation was handled very poorly and left us frustrated and disappointed, so we decided to leave.

If a specific product is mandatory for an appointment, this needs to be clearly communicated beforehand, especially when the booking was made two weeks earlier. Customers should not discover new conditions only after arriving with their dogs.

After the eye problem during our previous visit and today’s lack of communication and professionalism, unfortunately we will not be returning.
